verdict.rationale: Anytype's developer portal announces an Anytype CLI that runs Anytype "as a headless server for automation and scripting" (anytype-docs-2). The headless server exposes the documented, versioned local API with a published OpenAPI spec, which scripts and agents can drive programmatically (anytype-docs-1, anytype-supp-openapi-v2, anytype-docs-5). The headless capability rests on a single short announcement, with no setup detail shown. missing for 10: detailed CLI/headless setup documentation, explicit CI usage guidance or examples (e.g., auth/key provisioning in pipelines), independent or hands-on corroboration of headless operation.
